body: Every deep dive ends with tools/valuation/worksheet.py (standard library only; runs on the Pi). Input: one JSON of company figures (price, shares, net debt, base-year revenue/EBIT/PAT/FCF, economic NOPAT margin, ROIIC, cost of equity default India 12.5% / US 9.5%, terminal growth 5% / 3%, 10 years) plus bear/base/bull scenarios (growth yr1->yrN, end margin, ROIIC, exit P/E, probability) and a blow-up probability. Model: value-driver DCF, FCF = NOPAT x (1 - g/ROIIC), linear fades, TV = NOPAT(1+tg)(1 - tg/ROIC)/(r - tg). Outputs one Markdown section: (a) reverse DCF - revenue CAGR implied by price, year-1 growth fading to terminal, margin needed, IRR the price offers on the base case, feasibility flag when reinvestment > 100% of NOPAT; (b) scenario DCF -> probability-weighted value, bear downside, 5-yr multiples using stated exit P/E next to the DCF-consistent P/E at year 5 (gap flagged), and P(>=2x/3x/5x), P(<=0.5x), P(blow-up), EV and median 5-yr multiple via lognormal spread per scenario; (c) twin-engine EPS CAGR needed for 2x/3x/5x at each exit P/E and the re-rating share; (d) temperature vs own P/E history (n>=5), sector median and Nifty bands; (e) CoE x growth and TG x margin sensitivity. Rules: use economic margins (pre-Ind AS 116, core ex other income, after SBC, adjusted for one-offs); leases out of net debt when rent is in the margin; every input source-tagged or [EST] with method. Guide: research_notes/Templates/valuation_and_decision.md.

data.temp_bands: <0.7 cold, 0.7-0.9 cool, 0.9-1.1 normal, 1.1-1.5 warm, 1.5-2 hot, >=2 very hot

title: Standard valuation worksheet v1 (stage 5): reverse DCF, scenario DCF, twin engine, temperature, sensitivity
